# Keep helper-module names distinct from element-module and test-fixture names

CustomElementUtils.mjs is a shared PascalCase utility module exporting lowerCamelCase defineLazyCustomElement; its packaged URI uses that exact case. The widget test uses browser_customElementUtils.js and a customElementUtils.html fixture, while the element fixture pairs test-element.mjs with TestElement and the test-element tag. Match each artifact's existing family and exact import case. The broader tag/module/class pairing rule is already learned and is reused here rather than redefined.

Scope: Custom-element utility and fixture file naming.
